description: A formal residential front entry photographed from standing eye-level in a centered symmetrical composition, capturing the full facade of the entryway at dusk. The house exterior is smooth white stucco with crisp white painted mouldings and window surrounds. The door is white painted wood with glass panels and a brushed nickel handle set. Three broad limestone or travertine steps with a slightly rough natural surface lead up to the door landing. On either side of the steps sit two large square concrete planters in dark charcoal grey, each containing a precisely clipped conical boxwood topiary of identical height. A small bronze dog sculpture is positioned on the step landing, adding a charming domestic detail. The facade shows additional multi-pane divided-light windows to the right. Warm amber light pours from the wall-mounted positions flanking the door, washing the white stucco and picking out the moulding details in relief. The deep blue twilight sky is visible above. The mood is formal, welcoming, and classically composed.
